email_subject: Application - Founding Creator and Social Media Associate
email_body:
Dear LINEAL Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Founding Creator and Social Media Associate role. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, SEO, and social media, I'm excited about the opportunity to capture LINEAL's journey and tell stories that make people want to follow along.

At Episto, I've honed my skills in content strategy and production, writing keyword-targeted blogs and building WordPress sites. On my own project, mirook.com, I've designed and built a multi-page site, integrated social media, and implemented structured data to boost visibility—showing my ability to own the full content journey from idea to upload.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available for onsite events and travel. I'm comfortable with video editing and social media tools, and I'm eager to bring a creator mindset to LINEAL's channels, from fight nights to behind-the-scenes content.

I'd love to discuss how I can contribute to growing LINEAL's community. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear LINEAL Team,

I'm thrilled to apply for the Founding Creator and Social Media Associate position. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation and a passion for storytelling, I'm drawn to LINEAL's mission to bring the raw, unfiltered world of combat sports to a global audience. This role isn't just about posting—it's about producing content that makes people feel like they're part of the journey, and that's exactly what I love to do.

In my current role at Episto, I've taken ownership of on-page SEO and content creation for client websites, from keyword research to publishing. I've built and maintained WordPress sites, written engaging blog content, and used analytics tools to refine strategies. This experience has taught me how to create content that not only looks good but performs well—a skill I'd bring to LINEAL's social channels.

My independent project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to manage the entire content lifecycle. I designed and built the site, integrated social media, and implemented structured data to improve visibility across search engines. This project demonstrates my initiative and my knack for combining creativity with technical know-how—qualities essential for a founding creator.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am fully available for onsite events, shoots, and travel. I'm comfortable with video editing, social media tools, and the fast-paced environment of live events. I'm eager to collaborate with founders, athletes, and partners to create recurring formats and capture the energy of fight nights.

I'm excited about the opportunity to grow LINEAL's community and make people want to follow the journey. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
